name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: `key_lost` is defined as losing the key while the door is closed, so its description already holds the condition; a plain hard `Absence(key_lost)` correctly expresses 'don't drop the key while the door is still closed'. A `Precedence(door_open, key_lost)` would wrongly require opening the door. The rule-only task needs no goal, so the empty `FINAL_STATES` is valid.

texts: Do not drop the key while the door is still closed.
